mapper.insert: INSERT INTO story (child_id, title, situation_type, emotion, is_generated, created_at) VALUES (#{childId}, #{title}, #{situationType}, #{emotion}, #{isGenerated}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT story_id , child_id , title , situation_type /* ⚠ emotion 을 빠뜨리면 미리 만든 이야기를 꺼내 쓸 때 감정이 null 로 나간다. 그러면 화면이 주소의 ?emo= 기본값(슬픔)으로 캐릭터를 그려, 기쁜 이야기에 우는 얼굴이 붙는다(2026-08-20 지적). */ , emotion , is_generated FROM story WHERE story_id = #{storyId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO story_node (story_id, node_order, stage_type, narration, question_text, choice_data) VALUES (#{storyId}, #{nodeOrder}, #{stageType}, #{narration}, #{questionText}, #{choiceData})
mapper.sql: node_id , story_id , node_order , stage_type , narration , question_text , choice_data
mapper.select: SELECT FROM story_node WHERE story_id = #{storyId} ORDER BY node_order
SELECT FROM story_node WHERE story_id = #{storyId} AND node_order = #{nodeOrder} ORDER BY node_id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM story WHERE child_id = #{childId}
SELECT emotion FROM story WHERE child_id = #{childId} AND emotion IS NOT NULL ORDER BY story_id DESC LIMIT 1
